basic_details.job_title: NIT Goa Student Activity & Sports Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Goa (NIT Goa) is filling one post of Student Activity & Sports (SAS) Officer on a purely temporary basis for six months, extendable by another six months on satisfactory performance. The consolidated pay is Rs. 40,000 per month with a Master's degree and Rs. 50,000 per month with a Ph.D. degree. A Master's degree in physical education or sports sciences (or an equivalent degree) with at least 60% marks is required. Applications are submitted through a Google form, and the last date is 12 December 2026.

age_limit.details: The age limit printed for the post is 35. Age relaxation will be as per GOI Norms. The notice does not print an age cut-off date. | The notice does not say anything about a desirable qualification or experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

qualification.details: Post Essential Qualification Student Activity & Sports (SAS) Officer Master's degree in physical education or Master's degree in sports sciences or equivalent degree with at least 60% marks or its equivalent grade in CGPA/UGC point scale with good academic record from a recognized university/institute. | The notice also lists, as part of the required essential qualifications, a record of having represented the University / College at the inter-University / Inter-Collegiate competitions or the State and/or national championships.

how_to_apply: Fill the required data in the application form format attached to the notice. It asks for personal details, academic record, achievements at State and National level, extracurricular activities (including NCC), present employment, experience, three referees and a declaration with signature.
Compile the duly filled application form, the scanned copies of original documents and published papers (if any) into a single *.pdf file.
Open the Google form at https://forms.gle/734xSXus7jm3KDmv6 and attach the *.pdf file in the space provided.
Submit the Google form by 12 December 2026.
Write a correct and active email ID in the application, because all correspondence will be by email only.
For any information, email [email protected]. The Recruitment Cell address printed in the notice is Recruitment Cell, NIT Goa, Cuncolim, South Goa, Goa-403703.
Photocopies of transcripts, mark sheets, grade cards and certificates for all degrees
Documents supporting the achievements listed in the form
important_instructions: The number of posts advertised is merely an indication of the existing vacancies. The Institute reserves all rights to fill/not fill or increase/decrease any number of post(s). The decision of the Institute on all matters of selection is final and binding on the applicants. No candidate has any claim to an appointment letter as a matter of right, even after recommendation by the Selection (Interview) Committee. Shortlisted candidates and selected candidates will be informed by email only, so applicants are expected to check their email regularly. Any other applicable rule will be followed, although not mentioned in the notice.

content_sections.text: Incomplete application forms will not be considered for shortlisting. The shortlisting criteria will be as per the Institute requirements and norms, and may be set higher than advertised if required. Meeting the essential qualifications does not entitle a candidate to an interview call. The interview will be conducted in offline mode. Timings will be shared by email only after scrutiny of the applications. The interview date is not specified in the notice.
